InVideo AI vs VEXI: AI Video or Social Media in One App?
InVideo AI turns scripts and footage into videos. VEXI makes the video, designs and writes the post, and schedules and posts it.
InVideo AI makes videos from a prompt. Here is how it compares with one app that makes the post and keeps your feed going.

InVideo AI is an AI video editor and generator. Give it a script or an idea, or upload footage, and its AI plans the shots, edits on a timeline and generates video and images. Plans are per seat: Starter is $10 a month billed yearly ($20 monthly), Plus is $30 ($60 monthly) and Max is $75 billed yearly. Its pricing page lists no no-cost plan.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

The difference is what happens after the video. InVideo AI gives you the file and a share link. Designing the rest of your posts, writing captions and putting it all out every week is still on you. VEXI does the whole job. VEXI costs more than InVideo AI: plans are $199, $399 or $599 a month. What you pay for is the work you no longer do.
You Get A File, Not A Post
After export, InVideo AI offers a link to share or a share button. Its pages describe no scheduling to your social accounts.
VEXI schedules and posts to your connected accounts itself.
Some reviewers report credits used up before they got a video they could use, and refunds refused once credits were spent.
InVideo AI makes videos. Designed graphics, carousels and the caption that goes with each post come from somewhere else.
VEXI designs the post with your logo, colors, fonts and voice. Tap anything on the design to change it.
InVideo AI's Trustpilot profile is rated 1.8. Some reviewers report odd AI output and support that loops through an AI agent.
Edits your video: cuts, B-roll, music, captions
